breakdown.description: The prompt reverses the stated factor-of-safety definition; with n = S_y / σ_avg, the working stress should appear in the denominator, not the numerator.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly defines the factor of safety as n = S_y / σ_avg (yield strength divided by average stress), matching the ground truth. The incorrect intermediate instruction that described n = σ_avg / S_y (working-to-yield stress ratio with stress in the numerator) has been removed and is not repeated in the output.
